services.title: Collision repair
services.body: Body panels are straightened, replaced and refinished to match the factory line.

reviews.author: Pedro Arruda
reviews.text: Great service and consideration from the entire team at this location. Kept me updated weekly, sometimes even twice a week. All their work was done right during the peak of the holiday season and they managed to finish my vehicle almost a month before the finish date. I was recommended this location from someone else, and they truly deserved the recommendation, as I will also recommend them for anyone else in the future. Patrick and Robyn were genuine and nice people and always helpful.

reviews.author: Patricia Petersen
reviews.text: I have seen paint repair work that did not age well, so I decided to wait a few years before leaving this review. As it turns out, 5 years. I am happy to report that the paint on my repair is still absolutely beautiful. I cannot tell it from the original paint on the rest of the car. The service level and attention to detail are also excellent. Will always be my first choice.

reviews.author: Beth D
reviews.text: Very pleased with the work completed by 42 Collision. From the beginning quote communication was great through entire process. The prices were very fair/reasonable and they even found a less expensive alternative for one part which I am grateful for. The truck looked like new after the repairs and paint job. Staff is friendly and professional. I have worked with 42 Collision in the past to complete other smaller work. This was a much bigger job, and I returned for the high quality work, fair prices, and I know can trust them. I highly recommend 42 Collision.

reviews.author: Marie
reviews.text: I had originally called another body shop on the recommendation of the insurance company of the guy who had hit me. Their customer service was awful, so I looked online for another nearby shop with better reviews and found this place. They were so friendly and efficient with everything. Robyn really took the time to get my rental car squared away when the insurance agent refused to return my calls to set up the rental. My car was ready a few days before the estimated time and it looks good as new! Hopefully I never need body work again, but if I do, I won't hesitate to give them a call!

reviews.author: Alesia King
reviews.text: Great work on my vehicle. Can't even tell it's been repaired. Everyone is soooo kind and make you feel they truly appreciate your business. Love the relationship between them, the insurance company and car rental and how smooth the process was. Need body work done, give them a try. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: John Smith
reviews.text: Made an appointment for my estimate and was given undivided attention to my problem with Kristi Coats. She explained the entire process to me and what to expect going forward. Parts were ordered brought my car in on Monday, rental car was set up,I was good to go.Got a follow up call Wednesday letting me now my repair was on time and would be ready as scheduled for Friday. When I came to pick up my car I looked it over and it looked good as new. Glad I came here for my repair and would highly recommend to any one else who needs a collision repair.

reviews.author: Meagan Gunter
reviews.text: I recently got into a accident and my passenger door was completely crushed in . I called and set up an appointment to get an estimate , Kristi the owner/estimator was time efficient in writing up my estimate for the damage. The insurance company said they were a nationwide on your side facility and approved the repairs just like that. Robyn at the front desk helped me get a rental within 20 minutes I was in my rental and leaving my vehicle for the repairs since I couldn't drive it from what they explained to me was a non-drive vehicle . The service is great and the quality in work is even better . I couldn't have asked for a more convenient location and better repair facility to do the repairs .

reviews.author: Rená Keith
reviews.text: I haven’t even got my car fixed yet, but I am blown away with the customer care Robyn has given me! She has been patient with all my questions, rescheduling and even took care of steps arranging a rental car that I should have done. I believe in every job that employees should be “noticed” more. Robyn I notice you go above and behind the average standard of customer service. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Michelle. Logan
reviews.text: I had to do a lot of research to find someone to repair my car after I was hit . Not to mention the persons insurance did everything possible to delay the process ! 42 Collision not only repaired my car from where I was hit, but I asked them to repair some things I needed that I paid them for !!!! These people are the real deal! Professional, on time , communication is fantastic, and when you pick up your car that is now 7 years old, it looks like the day you drove it off the lot brand new !!!! Kristie and Robyn…. Bomb.com!!! Please go there for any repair needs !!!!!! Truly the best !

reviews.author: tiff laf
reviews.text: Save your $. I had a fender bender and was told it would take 4 days to fix my car. After 6 days it was supposed to be ready because they had to order a different part. I got there and see that my car isn’t ready. When I pointed out to kristi that it wasn’t complete she got extremely rude and starting yelling at me and my husband. It got so bad I had to ask her why she was talking to me the way she was. She stormed off and threw her hands in the air saying , “ I don’t know” It took them 11 business days to fix my car and I got it back and now my windshield wiper doesn’t work!!! I bought my car brand new and have never been in an accident. How did I get my car back and now my wiper is broke? It was problems with them from day one. I hope they don’t treat everyone like this. I honestly don’t see how they are still in business. Now I have to take my car to a different shop because of something they broke! I am furious about my experience at this place and will never ever take my car there again. I will also recommend that no one I know take their car there. Horrible horrible service! I wish I could give 0 stars.

reviews.author: Jenn Jones
reviews.text: Kristi coats the owner of this establishment is rude and hateful. We were trying to use them to cover an accident we had. I made an appointment for a estimate, when I dropped it off I was told it would be a few days for an estimate! Ok great. Called 5 days later- oh your next on the list. Called 6 days later, or were really busy!! We understand that - just be honest. Well why don’t you just come get your car? Uhm ok! We sure will! And let everyone know how “wonderful” (super sarcasm) your customer service is. But she’s the owner so she obviously doesn’t care at all!

reviews.author: Christine Stilley
reviews.text: A deer ruined my day and my Jeep but 42 Collision kissed my boo-boo and made it all better again. I thought for sure that my Jeep was a total loss but Kristi and the team saved me from a new car payment. They worked quickly and my Jeep looks even better than before! I had never purchased a BRAND NEW vehicle but in 2015 decided it was time. So off to the dealership I went to find the perfect Cherokee for me. All the bells & whistles!! And I love my Jeep. I have maintained it, parked it very far away from other cars in lots, washed it every 2 weeks, and treated it like it was $30,000 because it was. After almost 5 years, my Jeep still looked brand new. It didn't have a single ding or scratch....until Friday March 8, 2019. I was on my way down 42E from Clayton toward my office in Raleigh when out of nowhere a deer darted in the road. I didn't have time to react. Struck the poor thing going 60+ MPH. Fur and hooves went flying!! And my Jeep was no more.....until Kristi got her hands on it!! Thank you gals for working magic and getting me rolling again!! It looks brand new again.

reviews.author: Melody Brathwaite
reviews.text: I can't begin to explain how amazing my truck looked after 42 Collision finished doing the repairs. The professionalism from start to finish made the entire process painless. Another thing that made me tear up was how clean my interior was like it had never been touched. Thank you so much to all the hard working people there. I'm one very satisified customer. Also the referred me to enterprise off 70 in Clayton for a rental. They were equally fantastic. Gave me a newer car to drive in no time. Can't thank you all enough!

reviews.author: Wesley Moore
reviews.text: Originally gave them a great review for the work on my car, but took my sons car to them and have had the worst experience. They replaced the hood and front bumper on my sons car and when we went to pick it up the hood was misaligned, so we had to point that out to them and then had to wait for them to take it back in the shop to fix it. Not sure why it was not inspected before we were told to come pick it up. After less than 2 months of driving the car the bumper was hanging off the right side of the car. We took it back to them and they told us we must have hit a curb or something and they would not fix it. My son had driven the car for 2 years with no issues of hitting, or catching the bumper on the curb and he said he had not hit anything since the repairs were made that would cause the bumper to fall off. Now the paint is peeling off the bumper on the left side and it looks terrible. These issues are certainly going to cost us when we go to trade it in. Not sure if they used cheap parts, or if it was the workmanship, but regardless, the second experience with 42 Collision has been way less than satisfactory. Should have updated this review sooner, but the paint peeling from the bumper was the last straw. Would not recommend 42 Collision to anyone.

reviews.author: Theresa Rogers
reviews.text: Very good top notch work. My car was rear ended and I was stressed out. The staff at 42 collision took care of me and my car. They keep you informed every step of the way and do all they possibly can to help through the process. Special thanks to Robyn, she knows what she’s doing and will go out of her way to help you. My car looks fantastic, just like day I bought it, thanks again to everyone at 42 Collision.

reviews.author: Keith Faison
reviews.text: A quality establishment that truly understands what world class customer service should look like. I took my Suzuki in for repair from an accident and from the moment the young lady at the front desk answered the phone to Christy’s responsiveness to my needs I was highly satisfied with their level of professionalism and custom work on my car. I will never use anyone else.

reviews.author: g mb
reviews.text: We have used 42 collision a couple of different times and the work has always been fantastic. Any issues or concerns were taken care of as soon as they were brought to their attention. This past week, my bumper got hit in a parking lot and I knew right away where I was bringing it to get fixed. We were getting ready to go out of town and I must admit I was a little embarrassed to drop off my car because the inside needed a serious detail job. It has been so hot lately that I kept putting it off! Well imagine my surprise when I picked up my car ....it looked like it was fresh off of the car lot! They not only did a great job fixing the bumper, but the car was completely detailed inside and out! Thanks for an awesome job! Oh and it also does not hurt that the front desk ladies are fabulous as well!!

reviews.author: Tim Totten
reviews.text: 42 Collision Center did a great repair on my truck. The best part was their professionalism. They also treated me right and went out of their way to be helpful and kind. You won't go wrong choosing this business.

reviews.author: Gary Peters
reviews.text: I purchased a used Lexus. The front bumper was not properly connected and the interior mirror needed adjustment. Kristi saw to it that everything was perfectly repaired in less than 15 minutes. At no charge! FANTASTIC!

reviews.author: Nic Ole
reviews.text: I stopped by this family owned business to get my window wrapped after it was broke and was greeted by the nicest family in town. They quickly offered to help me out and did a fantastic job securing my window. I highly recommend this shop for all of your auto needs! Thank you so much

reviews.author: Dale Cook
reviews.text: Recently I had hail storm damage to both of my cars, so I decided to check with a couple of local body shops in Clayton to see not only what kind of turnaround I would be looking at for getting the repairs, but how well the business would do in terms of quality work and friendliness from their staff. The first body shop I checked with in Clayton had mediocre reviews, and when I went there it wasn't hard to see why. They were unfriendly, disorganized, and acted like they could care less if they got my business or not. From there I went to 42 Collision Center who had rave reviews, and when I arrived it became immediately apparent why. They treated me like family, gave me a turnaround time that was half the time it would have taken the other shop, and everything there was extremely organized. Needless to say I went with them for both of my cars and glad I did. They got both cars back to the way they looked before the storm, and even though the paintless dent repair people that worked with them had a little snafu with one of my windows, they made sure the dent repair guys would cover the cost of fixing it. I'd also like to add that during my conversations with them I found out the father (Jerry) of the family who owns and operates 42 Collision was brothers with our previous plumber who had passed away not too long ago, who had also operated his business with the same level of integrity that 42 Collision is run with. Not only will I consider them as the ONLY place to get body work done in the future should anything ever happen again, but I will be referring everyone I know to them.

reviews.author: Baxter Matheson
reviews.text: Jerry Coats is a honest and fair person to work with on any issue concerning collision repair or painting. He has done a few jobs for me and I am very satisfied with their work. I would recommend him for anything to do with auto collision. Best body man I know.

reviews.author: Samantha
reviews.text: My husband & I have taken both of our vehicles here for repair. So far, I have no complaints! They make sure you're taken care of & they work around your schedule. Fast & excellent service!

reviews.author: Leeann Sorenson
reviews.text: These folks are our go-to body shop. They are reasonable, and provide great work. We have had two of our cars repaired there (both more than once---oops!!), and been completely satisfied every time.

reviews.author: Patricia Ellsworth
reviews.text: Quality work & in these days of virtually non-existent customer service, 42 Collision offered frequent, honest & pleasant communication, were easy to get up with & accommodated our scheduling needs. Great place & people to do business with.

reviews.author: ROBYN MCCLANAHAN
reviews.text: What a great job they did on my vehicle. From beginning to end top of the line service. Honest and fair. Workman ship was the best I have seen. Will use them again and again.

reviews.author: Sherrie Hunt
reviews.text: 42 Collision has done repairs twice for us on my daughter's car. They are very professional and timely. They do great work. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: CJ Deans
reviews.text: It was a positive experience from beginning to end. They kept me updated the whole time and finished a day earlier than expected. Car was deep cleaned on the inside when I got it back too! I definitely will come back here in the future!

reviews.author: Janice Sharron
reviews.text: Fantastic Job! Great communication with Robyn and Chrissy ! My Honda Accord looks great after getting hit! Very satisfied, prompt and very professional!

reviews.author: Maurizia Stillinger
reviews.text: They had my car done on time and did awesome paint match. There pricing is good. And did great work would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Elvira Savaglio
reviews.text: I have to say that from start to finish the people at 42 collision are the upmost professionals.Everything went very smoothly,the day I dropped off my truck the rental was waiting for me use and was called promptly when my truck was ready.They did a fantastic job on the repairs I'm very happy with thier work.

reviews.author: Glen Jacobson
reviews.text: Robyn who works the front desk has to be the rudest most ignorant person I have ever had the displeasure of working with. One of the most self centered people I ever met. She does not care about other people’s feelings or situations. She is old and old school and needs to get with the times. I will never recommend this shop as long as she is working the front desk

reviews.author: robin endress
reviews.text: Love the folks at Collision 42. Everyone from the owner to the receptionist and paint and body guys were fantastic! These folks took extra tlc with our '67 GTO! Special thanks to Jorge for the amazing job on the body!

reviews.author: Joel Parker
reviews.text: Very nice looking shop. Very knowledgeable and fast. Although my service was through an insurance claim, I would definitely recommend them to those needing good service.

reviews.author: Jacqui Harmeling
reviews.text: These people do amazing work, and they keep you informed every step of the way. They are professional, cheerful, and genuinely concerned about their customers. Five stars!

reviews.author: Vail Brennan
reviews.text: I haven’t seen the condition of the car or the quality but all I can say is awful customer service. Just be sure to read your fine print before you make a commitment to this establishment.

reviews.author: TD Crouse
reviews.text: Kristi Coats, the owner is awesome, and has a great support team. Excellent work, the first time through. Could not ask for more.

reviews.author: T.J. Snyder
reviews.text: Very professional staff and great work! My car was damaged by hail and when I got it back, you could never tell anything had happened!

reviews.author: Papa Bear01
reviews.text: I have had the great misfortune of having brought all but one of my vehicles to them....that being said....I'm glad I found them the first time and that they do such excellent work.....never a disappointment

reviews.author: Virginia Sanders
reviews.text: I recently had an unusual issue and the staff resolved it quickly and professionally. I will definitely return and recommend them if I need their services again in the future.

reviews.author: Lara Keating
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, helpful and courteous. I loved the text updates of the progress being made. 42 Collision Center made this whole ordeal, a not so painful process!

reviews.author: Ian Rumbles
reviews.text: What a delight to have body work done by a highly professional team. Robin and Kristie made the experience low stress and pleasant. Highly recommend this place

reviews.author: Julie Belanger
reviews.text: You know when a small business is locally owned in Clayton and cared for. The owner, Kristi Coats, was completely hands on. Dr. Julie Belanger, InSight Family and Pediatric Eye Care.

reviews.author: Robert Ancheta
reviews.text: Called to get a quote on a paint job on a few body parts and sharply was told they weren't interested. I'm confused and appalled but after an answer like that I let, it seems the owner, hang up and I'll do business elsewhere

reviews.author: Sherry
reviews.text: They took their time to get my car right after I was rear ended on 40. I even had to take it back to them to have some things tweaked. They fixed it with no questions asked.

reviews.author: Joel Perrego
reviews.text: 42 Collision had the best price, and backed it up with great work and quick turnaround. I would recommend them to family and friends.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: Went to shop to get an estimate on minor body work and was told I needed an appointment for an estimate. I went someplace else.
